rationale: The described software plans, dimensions, and optimizes wireless or wired backhaul networks using specified transmission technologies and standards—a conventional network design function.
evidence_spans: plan, dimension and optimize any wireless or wired backhaul network. It includes support for the design of the latest 5G X-haul technologies relying on point-to-point and/or point-to-multipoint wireless transmission, and incorporates all the latest ITU and 3GPP specifications
